messages:
marie_cs: Heads-up — Crestline asked to shift load start by ~2h. Need to check quota headroom and autoscale policy. @engr_jun @sre_liam
engr_jun: ok. what's the planned qps and token size?
marie_cs: baseline 120 qps, peak 480 qps over a 45m ramp. median token length ~300. Customer worried about latency for short-tail requests.
sre_liam: 480 qps with 300 tokens => reserved pool should be fine but we need to bump target_instances to 6. current autoscale max=4. I can temporarily raise to 8 for the window.
engr_jun: bumping max fine. also enable prefix KV caching for common prompts (we saw ~30% token latency win in last run).
customer_pm_kara: Kara from Crestline — confirming we'll run a gradual ramp, 15m warm, then 3-step ramp: 25%, 60%, 100%. Need visibility for SLA and renewal team asked for post-run metrics.
marie_cs: noted. We'll record P95 latency, error %, and token cost delta. @finance_rohan do you need pre-approval for extra reserved hours?
finance_rohan: quick calc — 3 extra GPUs for 4 hours => send me estimate, I can approve emergency budget. Prefer to use burst capacity credits where possible.
engr_jun: load test plan (short):
```bash
# using k6 wrapper to exercise the endpoint with tokenized payloads
k6 run --vus 120 --duration 15m scripts/llm_ramp.js --env TOKEN_SIZE=300
# then step up to simulate peak: 360 vus -> 720 vus in 3 steps
```
I'll upload artifacts to /tmp/loadruns/crestline-1715512345 and link in the huddle.
sre_liam: set alarm: >5% 5xx or p95>300ms -> trigger rollback and notify on-call. Also pre-wire model-fallback route to quantized-xxsmall variant.
marie_cs: what about priming the KV cache? we should replay top 50 prefixes during warmup.
engr_jun: agreed — short prefix replay during warmup. attaching quick curl:
```json
{"prefix":"Hello, can you summarize the last 3 messages?"}
```
customer_pm_kara: thanks — we'll have product folks watch dashboards. Also flag for renewals: they expect 99.9% next quarter; if this run shows instability we need a mitigation note for the AM and renewal lead.
marie_cs: capturing that — we'll produce a short post-run report (P95, errors, unit cost uplift) and share with renewal_sre and the AM. Scheduling 30m wrap with Crestline 30m after completion.
deploy-bot: deploy started: dedicated-pool-bump v2 -> scheduled at 1715513000 :shipit:
engr_jun: FYI I'll be on-call 1715512400-1715513200 for any rollback or hotfixes.
marie_cs: final checklist before we start: (1) finance ok for burst, (2) autoscale max set to 8, (3) KV prefix cache enabled, (4) k6 scripts uploaded and smoke-passed, (5) rollback policy/alerting wired. Anything missing?
customer_pm_kara: please add an enablement one-pager for our infra team — bullets on retry/backoff, token limits, and recommended request sizing.
marie_cs: will produce the one-pager and attach to the wrap. logging TODOs added and I'll ping the renewal team after the run. :thumbsup:
